description: Issue 24 pilot: Raelen's A Bundle of Trouble (Classic 5545, 8 bundles; owner-approved adaptation 4) restored after the final quest filter and played on the map: a few bundle markers near Eastvale, ~2 s gather bar on the chosen marker (tap again to cancel), one bundle into the real bag per success, attack roll once per attempt (attackChance 0.05, approved by the owner 2026-11-26) that interrupts the attempt and opens the existing ambush fight; the pending attack is saved so reload cannot skip or reroll it; hand-in at 4/4 takes exactly 4 bundles once.
